limitations: This is a first-party source, regression and reliability audit, not a formal security certification.
Upstream FreeRDP, XOVI, LiTerm, Qt and operating-system internals were not exhaustively audited.
No production deployment, public release archive or signed release manifest was changed.
No authenticated live remote desktop was manipulated during this audit. Native RDP logic and isolated profile UI were tested separately.

fixed_findings.problem: Arbitrary files inside website/, including source and a legacy private database when present, were publicly routable.
fixed_findings.fix: Explicit public entrypoint/asset routing, hidden/traversal/NUL rejection and HTTP regressions.

fixed_findings.problem: Each concurrent archive download allocated the entire file in memory; HEAD APIs did not match GET.
fixed_findings.fix: 64 KiB streaming, opened-file size headers, disconnected-client handling and consistent HEAD APIs.

fixed_findings.problem: A stalled feed blocked the queue indefinitely; abort callbacks and already-scheduled continuations could mutate a newer refresh.
fixed_findings.fix: Per-request timeout, generation/identity ownership, silent cancellation, completed-request release, article-switch cancellation and empty-address validation.

fixed_findings.problem: Page/CSS requests could remain pending indefinitely and deferred file rejection could replace a newer page.
fixed_findings.fix: Bounded page timeout, six-second optional CSS fallback, generation checks and callback detachment before abort.

fixed_findings.problem: Stale persistent status could be attributed to the wrong operation; successful/current terminal statuses were not consumed; checks could hang.
fixed_findings.fix: Correlated request IDs, terminal-state handling, manifest validation, request timeout and unload ownership checks.

fixed_findings.problem: The native engine stored a connection password even when the profile editor disabled Remember password.
fixed_findings.fix: Explicit --no-save-password propagation and a separate sanitized persistence copy while retaining the current in-memory session password.

fixed_findings.problem: The changed-certificate callback silently accepted a different known server certificate.
fixed_findings.fix: Persist first-use trust through FreeRDP, reject changed certificates and show a specific connection error. First-use trust still requires a trusted network.

fixed_findings.problem: The configured work directory was recursively removed; competing runs could clear requests or overwrite active status.
fixed_findings.fix: Unique private temporary workspace, early lock ownership, validated request metadata, request-correlated status and exit-on-signal cleanup.

fixed_findings.problem: Existing app files were removed before the replacement copy completed; backups could share a timestamp; manual installs lacked an internal checksum gate.
fixed_findings.fix: Verify checksums before mutations, acquire an install lock, stage all apps first, rename prepared replacements, restore the displaced app after failure/signal and create unique private backups.

fixed_findings.problem: A local build failure could invoke device cleanup; cleanup modified restored E2E settings, could block on an orphan FIFO and could trigger firmware failure reboot during maintenance.
fixed_findings.fix: Setup ownership gating, bounded FIFO shutdown, exact settings restoration, cleanup error propagation, input-test lock, scoped runtime failure-service masking and default-disabled screen capture. RDP/Care tests now use live geometry instead of stale coordinates.

fixed_findings.problem: The bundled QTFB shim referenced a broken source symlink and could not build independently.
fixed_findings.fix: Bundle the matching client sources, require C++17, test source parity and build both shim targets.

fixed_findings.problem: SSH user/host input could be interpreted as an option; Windows free-space checks omitted Books/Dots and did not require the new temporary-directory tool.
fixed_findings.fix: Pass username through -l and terminate SSH options with --; include all app directories and mktemp in preflight fixtures and checks.

fixed_findings.problem: The real tablet failed to finish opening a 431-move saved game while synchronous replay occupied the UI thread. Large Undo used the same blocking replay path.
fixed_findings.fix: Incremental replay with bounded slices, throttled progress text, disabled board mutation until complete, and Close that never saves a partial reconstructed game. Large Undo uses the same incremental path.

remaining_risks.detail: freerdp_connect still runs synchronously. The connecting screen can stop reacting during DNS/TLS/authentication waits. Moving connection setup off the UI loop needs a separate, carefully tested cancellation/thread-ownership change.
Remembered RDP passwords are hexadecimal, not encrypted. Root-only files limit access but do not protect against someone with root/physical access.
Qt XMLHttpRequest buffers replies before first-party parsing limits apply. Pathological large HTML/feed/book responses still need a streaming or transport-level byte budget.

Incremental replay keeps the native UI responsive, but the actual 431-move game still took about 40 seconds to reconstruct on the tablet (large Undo about 36 seconds). A validated snapshot/checkpoint cache would reduce subsequent cold-load latency without changing the rules.

Each app replacement is staged and recoverable, but the complete multi-app/service update is not an all-or-nothing transaction. Earlier app replacements may remain after a later failure; retained backups are the recovery path.

Review upstream compiler warnings, test authenticated RDP and certificate changes against a controlled server, then build a new versioned signed release. Do not deploy by overwriting the currently published version.

production_read_only_head_checks.note: HEAD only; no database content was requested. The public server-source route still needs the separately approved website security deployment.
